2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:observe-live-usage and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Read my account's own usage day rows (stored bytes, work time, source bytes the engine counted) and keep each closed day as one usage observation per billed resource, ready to settle

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: resource-usage-observation (records:read, records:list, records:write); resource-usage-receipt (records:read, records:list, records:write); undefined (usage_days).
